description: Top up the apifare balance from the owner's standing auto-refill mandate (if the owner enabled one). Charges within the owner's configured limits and returns the new balance. Without a mandate, returns payment instructions to relay to the user.

amount_usd.description: Optional whole-dollar amount; defaults to the mandate's refill amount and is clamped to it

name: topup
title: Top up the balance (charges the owner's card)
